sn7.7:1.2: Atha kho suddhika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn7.7:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || 3.
sn7.7:1.4: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho suddhika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.7:2.4: so sujjhati || na aññā itarā pajā ti || || 4.
sn7.7:5.1: Evam vutte suddhika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.7:5.2: Abhikkantam bho Gotama abhikkantam bho Gotama || pa || 6.
sn7.7:5.3: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahatam ahosīti || || 1.
